descriptionChirho: Intransitive sense of becoming fat, prosperous, or enriched, attested in Qal and Pual stems across various inflections.
Active causative Piel sense of making someone or something fat, prosperous, or well-nourished.
Metaphorical Piel sense of accepting or regarding with favor, especially a sacrifice, from the image of making a burnt offering fat and pleasing.
Denominative Piel sense derived from deshen (fat-ashes), meaning to clear away the fatty ashes from the altar.
Hitpael reflexive sense of becoming gorged or glutted with fat, indicating excessive satiation.
Piel sense of anointing or smearing with oil or fat, distinct from general enrichment, with multilingual evidence consistently pointing to ritual or cosmetic anointing.
